#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <regex>
#include <sstream>
#include <algorithm>

int longestWords(const std::string& line) {
    if (line.empty()) return 0;
    int maxLen = 0;
    std::istringstream ss(line);
    std::string token;
    while (std::getline(ss, token, '_')) {
        maxLen = std::max(maxLen, (int)token.length());
    }
    return maxLen;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    std::string input;
    std::cin >> n >> input;

    std::string pattern = "\\([\\w_]*\\)";
    std::regex re(pattern);

    // Outside parts: non-matching segments
    std::sregex_token_iterator outIt(input.begin(), input.end(), re, -1);
    std::sregex_token_iterator outEnd;
    int longest = 0;
    for (; outIt != outEnd; ++outIt) {
        longest = std::max(longest, longestWords(outIt->str()));
    }

    // Inside parts: matching segments
    std::sregex_iterator inIt(input.begin(), input.end(), re);
    std::sregex_iterator inEnd;
    long long numberInside = 0; // Use long long to avoid overflow for large counts
    for (; inIt != inEnd; ++inIt) {
        std::string match = inIt->str();
        // Remove first and last characters (parentheses)
        std::string inside = match.substr(1, match.size() - 2);
        int cnt = 0;
        std::istringstream ss(inside);
        std::string token;
        while (std::getline(ss, token, '_')) {
            if (!token.empty()) ++cnt;
        }
        numberInside += cnt;
    }

    std::cout << longest << " " << numberInside << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
